entries.1fce4eaff583f579: A reportable segment that generates solar power and sells the electricity. Sales for the fiscal year ended August 2025 were ¥189 million (up 1.6% from the previous fiscal year), and segment profit (operating profit) was ¥75 million (up 29.5%). In the section on major facilities, the securities report lists solar power generation facilities as facilities of the head office (Mito, Ibaraki Prefecture), and states that they are shown including the land, structures, and machinery and equipment for installing the solar power generation facilities. Sales as a reportable segment are smaller than those of the facilities business.

It is the segment with the largest sales to external customers of the three reportable segments.

entries.8497b46271baeef5: A reportable segment that buys, sells, and leases real estate, among other activities. The securities report describes this segment's revenue as rental income and similar revenue under the accounting standard for lease transactions; sales for the fiscal year ended August 2025 were ¥1 million (up 8.3% from the previous fiscal year), and segment profit (operating profit) was ¥0 million. In the section on employees, the securities report states that the solar power generation business and the real estate business within Other Business are handled concurrently by the administration department. The section on major facilities lists leased land and buildings (Mito, Ibaraki Prefecture).

entries.e8c8cf4c89f28784: A reportable segment engaged in the design and construction of equipment work such as air conditioning and plumbing and sanitation, and the maintenance and management of equipment and machinery; of the three reportable segments, it is the one with the largest revenue from external customers. The Annual Securities Report describes it as a business covering equipment work in general, including building equipment work, renovation work, civil engineering work, plant work, and building care work. For the fiscal year ended August 2025, orders received for construction were ¥10,203 million (up 19.3% from the previous fiscal year), completed construction revenue was ¥8,944 million (up 3.6%), and segment profit (operating profit) was ¥1,538 million (up 34.3%). The Annual Securities Report gives the increase in completed construction revenue and the improvement in the construction profit margin as the reasons for the increase in profit.
